Context

The work in context.

A varied catalog needed a coherent identity and a product organization model that felt intentional.

Role, audience and objectives

Responsibility carried through the system.

Juan's role

  • Brand and commerce strategy
  • Art direction and visual system
  • Shopify theme development
  • Responsive storefront implementation
  • Product naming, organization, payment, email, and domain setup

Audience

  • People building training and recovery routines
  • Shoppers comparing performance and everyday products

Objectives

  • Create a distinctive editorial commerce language
  • Connect products through a system rather than isolated listings
  • Preserve clarity across dramatic light and dark sections

Behavioral lens

  • Attention guided by hierarchy rather than visual pressure
  • Continuity through a consistent product language

Context

VX Nexus connects training, recovery, cooling, and everyday wellness products through an editorial storefront rather than presenting them as an unrelated catalog.

Juan’s role

Juan handled brand direction, structure, visual design, Shopify theme development, responsive behavior, collections, payment setup, business email, domain configuration, and launch independently.

Visual direction

Monochrome photography, oversized type, warm-white and black fields, and a restrained green accent establish a clear identity. Product detail remains on calmer surfaces so the brand world does not reduce usability.

Evidence and limits

The live storefront demonstrates the editorial and commerce system. No performance metrics or claims about photography authorship are added.

Information architecture and visual direction

Important structural decisions.

Information architecture

  • Minimal global navigation
  • Editorial category stories
  • Product carousels and collections
  • Training, recovery, cooling, and essentials

Design decisions

  • Built a split light-and-dark visual axis
  • Used neon green selectively for orientation and emphasis
  • Balanced oversized typography with quieter product detail

Technical implementation

Infrastructure, responsive behavior, and access.

Email, forms, payments and platform

  • Shopify storefront
  • Custom theme development
  • Collections and product system
  • Payments, business email, domain configuration, and launch

Accessibility and responsive design

  • Accent color is not the only state indicator
  • High-contrast content surfaces
  • Responsive product controls

Available evidence

What can—and cannot—be claimed.

Available outcomes

  • A live independent Shopify commerce system

Limitations

  • No sales or conversion claims are published
  • Third-party photography authorship is not claimed

Reflection

What the project clarified.

Strong art direction works best when it gives a catalog a legible idea—not when it competes with the products.
